stack_residue.proof: Verified immutable CALL encodings plus final call nesting/depth; every corrected historical invocation and live shadow confirms exact final writer/address/value. No post-oracle byte copied.

conditional_termination: Core has no iteration bound, cycle detector or invented cycle rejection. Existing184 oracle cases terminate; arbitrary tables need not. Synthetic wrapping tests are explicitly terminating; no exhaustive termination claim.
final_flags: CMP0,0 retainsS0 Z1 AC1 P1 CY0 through final LDA/RET; every historical snapshot agrees.
multiple_callers: Original preceding actual CALL origin/encoding/target/state/SP/writes establishes callsite+3. No fixed resumePC; source/input-bound tokens reject other entries.
shared_dispatch: Only hybrid full-memory, record, count, pending-resume and explicit-body-isolation comparisons are shared. No ownership/ABI inference or compiler IR framework.
full_memory_comparison: All65536 bytes compared directly at historical shadows and every prepared/applied hybrid resume; no stack exemption.
unsupported_states: Selected scratch/table/return-stack aliases outside established scope
Wrong historical image/helper/caller code, canonical entry or CALL ancestry
Changed source/input, additional or omitted invocation, changed per-case complete entry state
General compiler semantics or new native operations
